system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant for Microsoft Teams workspace tasks.

scenarios.name: S1
scenarios.description: Reply to a message in a general channel of a team.

prompts.prompt_text: Hello, I'm Carol White, a UX Designer in the "TechCorp Solutions Team" (team_id: team_techcorp_001). I just received a notification that the Project Manager (Alice) has sent a welcome message in the General channel. Please reply to that message with the text: "Thanks Alice! Excited to be part of the team".

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM channel_messages WHERE team_id = 'team_techcorp_001' AND (reply_to_id IS NOT NULL AND reply_to_id <> '') AND json_extract(body_json, '$.content') = 'Thanks Alice! Excited to be part of the team'
